# couchbase-capella_outbound_private_endpoints (Data Source)

The data source to retrieve every outbound private endpoint on a cluster, newest first. Pending, failed and deleting endpoints are included.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "couchbase-capella_outbound_private_endpoints" "existing_outbound_private_endpoints" {
  organization_id = "ffffffff-aaaa-1414-eeee-000000000000"
  project_id      = "ffffffff-aaaa-1414-eeee-000000000000"
  cluster_id      = "ffffffff-aaaa-1414-eeee-000000000000"
}
```
